start.text:
Welcome to Stonerock News Corp's interactive coverage. The company is facing multiple bankruptcies, stranded ships, and erratic decisions by CEO @squidopiaomgcoolnessomgggg.

Choose your protagonist to navigate the chaos:

choices.text: Rick Sick Tick (Exposing the conspiracy)
Chick Van Miller (Trapped in the SS Mortus)
Nerdy News Reporter (Polyester Enthusiast)

rick_start.text:
You are Rick Sick Tick. You just exposed Stonerock on live TV, warning everyone that Squidopia is turning humans into cruise ships. You need to infiltrate Stonerock HQ to stop 'The Process'.

You arrive at the tall, gray building. Beside it is the abandoned Stonerock HQ. What do you do?

choices.text: Kick open the door to Stonerock HQ
Investigate the seal plushie factory next door

rick_factory.text:
You enter the factory. The Nerdy News Reporter runs inside, grabs a plushie, and screams: 'GUYS!!! IT'S 100% POLYESTER!!!'

Now that the distraction is sorted, you approach the abandoned Stonerock HQ.

choices.text: Kick open the door to Stonerock HQ

rick_hq.text: You step into the modern waiting room. You spot a vending machine selling StonerockCoin for $0.000000000000000001.

choices.text: Put a penny in to buy the dip
Ignore the vending machine and drag everyone to the elevator

rick_vending_death.text:
The vending machine instantly explodes, burying the waiting room under millions of physical StonerockCoins.

You are trapped beneath worthless metal. Nobody can dig you out.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

rick_elevator.text:
You step into the elevator. The floor display suddenly shifts into negative digits: [Floor: -15] then [Floor: -82].

The elevator crashes at the bottom. Trevor No is blocking the door.

choices.text: Ask Trevor to let you pass
Have the Nerdy Reporter tackle him

rick_trevor_no.text:
You ask Trevor if you can pass.

Trevor No: 'No.'

You are stuck in the elevator forever.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

rick_tackle.text:
The Nerdy News Reporter lunges forward, misses, slips, but then gets a surge of confidence from his suit:

'IT'S 100% POLYESTER! AND YOU'RE ABOUT TO GET POLYESTERED!'

He tackles Trevor No, clearing the path. You find a dark room where Squidopia is preparing to convert Chick Van Miller into the 'SS Chiccius'.

choices.text: Distract Chick Ban Miller (the chicken spy) with a worm
Offer Squidopia an investment in StonerockCoin

rick_scam_death.text:
Squidopia happily takes your money, immediately files for bankruptcy again, and uses his agents to lock you into the reactor hatch.

You are now part of the auxiliary fuel cell.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

rick_win_truth.text:
You throw a worm at the main console. Chick Ban Miller aggressively pecks at the worm, destroying the computer controls for 'The Process'.

Squidopia's plans are ruined! Chick Van Miller is saved, and you broadcast the truth to Orion City once and for all!

YOU WIN!

choices.text: Play Again

chick_start.text:
You are Chick Van Miller, former star reporter. You are trapped in a tight cell deep within the SS Mortus. Squidopia has locked you away to turn you into a cruise ship.

A silhouette emerges from the shadows.

choices.text: Scream for help
Whisper: 'Is that you, Peter?'

chick_scream.text:
Your screams attract Squidopia's armed Agents. They throw you into the glass containment tube early.

'The Process' begins. You are now the hull of the SS Chiccius.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

chick_peter.text:
The silhouette steps forward. It is Peter Pickle, the coworker who vanished after lunch!

Peter: 'I'm afraid... it's too late for us. But you can try the escape hatch before they start the reactor.'

choices.text: Search for the ventilation escape hatch
Wait for Chick Ban Miller to bring the keys

chick_keys_fail.text:
Chick Ban Miller appears at the window, but instead of bringing keys, he aggressively pecks at a worm and hops away.

The Agents find you and begin 'The Process'.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

chick_vents.text: You crawl through the hot, narrow ventilation shaft and emerge on the outer deck of the SS Mortus. Below is the harbor. Squidopia is standing near the reactor hatch.

choices.text: Jump into the ocean to swim away
Throw a stray polyester suit into the nuclear reactor

chick_ocean.text:
You jump into the ocean. However, you find yourself stranded at sea with zero food, zero water, and zero fuel.

You survive for 10 days, but Stonerock fails to pay the $2,000 towing fee. You are stuck here.

IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????

choices.text: Restart Adventure

chick_win.text:
The 100% polyester suit creates a massive static charge in the nuclear reactor. A loud explosion knocks the agents out and forces Squidopia to flee in his jetpack!

You escape on a life raft, ready to tell the world your story!

YOU WIN!

choices.text: Play Again

nerdy_start.text:
You are the Nerdy News Reporter. Your mommy bought you a brand-new suit. It's 100% Polyester!

You are standing outside Stonerock HQ. What do you do?

choices.text: Show off your polyester suit to Trevor No
Look for limited edition StonerockCoin flavors in the vending machine

nerdy_show_suit.text:
You run up to Trevor No and show off your suit.

Trevor No: 'No.'

You drop into tears and start crying for your mommy. This is embarrassing.

choices.text: Restart Adventure

nerdy_vending.text:
You put a penny into the vending machine. It explodes! Thousands of coins fly everywhere, but your polyester suit protects you from the blast.

You tumble down an elevator shaft and land right in front of Squidopia's control desk.

choices.text: Tackle Trevor No using raw polyester friction
Yell 'IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????' into the microphone

nerdy_yell.text:
You yell 'IS THIS THE END OF STONEROCK???????' so loudly that the sound waves shatter the glass containment unit, releasing Chick Van Miller!

Squidopia is startled and accidentally steps backward into his own nuclear reactor hatch.

You saved everyone by accident!

YOU WIN!

choices.text: Play Again
